component.name: Payneteasy API Key Pair Factory
component.summary: Generate an RSA key pair for the Payneteasy API

description.p: Native desktop app that generates an RSA-4096 key pair (PKCS#8, optional PKCS#1) for the Payneteasy API — a local, no-terminal replacement for the OpenSSL CLI. All cryptographic operations happen locally on the device.
